past_trivia.question: Which country has the most natural lakes?
past_trivia.fun_fact: Canada has over 60% of Earth's lakes.

past_trivia.question: Holding roughly 20% of the Earth's unfrozen surface fresh water, what Siberian body of water is the deepest lake in the world?
past_trivia.fun_fact: Lake Baikal is also considered the world's oldest lake, estimated to be between 25 and 30 million years old.
